body:
During T247's first full check on a loaded worktree, two tests failed once each and were green in isolation and in the final full run:
- test/browser/tutorial.test.ts - hit its 90s timeout.
- test/gateway/render-ocap.test.ts - 'the renderer could not start'.

Both are outside the T247 diff. The flaky rule (CLAUDE.md, Myk 2026-07-23): the moment a test is OBSERVED flaky, fixing it outranks the ticket in hand; measure both directions first (under load and in isolation, on a branch and on main) so blame lands on the test rather than a diff; the fix is never a widened assertion and never a retry loop - determine RAIL bug vs SPEC-ACCURACY bug. This ticket exists so the observation is not lost during a shipping day; triage is due the same day the queue clears.

Prior art: the T139 render-budget flake was a spec-accuracy bug (one number on two clocks - spawn vs bundle); render-ocap's 'could not start' smells like the same family (worker spawn under load). The tutorial timeout may be plain load arithmetic against a 90s ceiling on a machine running parallel builds - measure before concluding.

Acceptance criteria:
(a) Both tests measured under load and in isolation, on main; the failure mode named. Verify: measurements quoted in this ticket's closing PR or journal note.
(b) Each fix is a rail fix or a spec-accuracy fix, never a widened assertion; or an honest it.skip with this ticket id if same-day repair is impossible. Verify: the diff of the closing PR.
title: Two tests observed flaky under load on 2026-08-27 - triage before they train anyone
